requirements.title: Omitted POSITION= defaults to ASIS
requirements.definition: If POSITION= is omitted, the default value is ASIS.

pending.position-default-asis: No portable oracle observes the omitted POSITION= token ASIS directly. INQUIRE(POSITION=) is not a token oracle because 12.10.2.24 reports the connection's positioning state: REWIND if the connection was opened for positioning at its initial point, APPEND if opened for end positioning, ASIS if opened without changing position, or a constrained processor-dependent value after repositioning. For a new file, 12.5.6.15 separately states that the file is positioned at its initial point, so INQUIRE(POSITION=) is not guaranteed to report ASIS. For an existing file that is not connected, 12.5.6.15 makes the position resulting from ASIS processor dependent. For an already connected same-file OPEN, the portable position-unchanged behavior is owned by 12.5.6.1 p6 (registered as S12.5.6.1-009), which applies because no new connection is established and holds regardless of the omitted POSITION= default; do not duplicate that behavior under this facet. Future fixtures must not assert the omitted POSITION= default token or attribute same-connection position preservation to this rule.
